text_block_list.text:
After searching high and low for Mejiro 
Ramonu, who hadn't shown up for training, 
I found her engrossed in abstract 
paintings.
choice_data_list: ...Training time is already up, you know.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
—I was sprinting across the wilderness. 
Laying bare my raw, unvarnished love.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
It is not something that can be contained. 
For the number of colors known to humans 
is simply not enough.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
—However, it is a fact that I broke our 
plans. Allow me to apologize.

Though she likely had her own reasons, as 
her Trainer, I gave her the proper 
guidance.
